assumptions: Exact integer arithmetic; enumerate every nonsingular short Weierstrass model y^2=x^3+a*x+b over each listed prime field.
R=product over eight triple Frobenius roots of (q^2-root product); B=R*product_i(q+1-t_i)^2.
The twenty-dimensional model is (M1 tensor M2 tensor M3) direct sum two copies of q*Mi for each i.
Geometric identification uses standard elliptic-curve cohomology and Kunneth; no cycle-class computation or unramified group is computed.
All conclusions about l-adic determinants exclude l=p. No current parent-problem status is asserted.
target: Audit whether the imported B_X is the prime-to-characteristic determinant of all twenty H3 Frobenius eigenvalues, and isolate the unverified transfer from that determinant to unramified cohomology.
